import json,collections
cards=[json.loads(x) for x in open('items.jsonl')]
answers=[json.loads(x) for x in open('answers.jsonl')]
assert len(cards)==len(answers)==91
assert [x['card_id'] for x in cards]==[x['card_id'] for x in answers]
allowed={'type':set('word caps_display abbrev_label marker roman_lower digits_letters number punctuation noise handwriting foreign_script figure_ornament watermark show_through cut_fragment multi_line part_of_line other'.split()),'text':set('match minor wrong not_text unreadable'.split()),'crop':set('ok clipped extra na'.split()),'rotated':set('yes no'.split())}
for a in answers:
 assert set(a)=={'card_id','type','text','crop','rotated','detail'}
 for k,v in allowed.items(): assert a[k] in v
 assert isinstance(a['detail'],str)
 if a['text'] in ('wrong','minor'):assert '→' in a['detail']
for k in ('type','text','crop'):print(k,dict(collections.Counter(a[k] for a in answers)))
print('Count, order, fields and values validated.')
